app.accessible_description: Offline local AI music generation workspace.

lyrics.title: Lyrics Engine
lyrics.subtitle: Write, structure and revise lyrics with a local model.

song_forge.title: Song Forge
song_forge.subtitle: Turn lyrics and direction into a finished local render.

midi_studio.title: MIDI Studio
midi_studio.subtitle: Compose, arrange and humanize MIDI performances.

vocals.title: Vocal Suite
vocals.subtitle: Synthesize, convert, tune and separate vocal performances.

sfx.title: Sound Forge
sfx.subtitle: Generate production-ready sound effects from text.

mixer.title: Mix Console
mixer.subtitle: Balance tracks, shape stereo space and prepare a master.

ai_producer.title: AI Producer
ai_producer.subtitle: Orchestrate a complete local production from one brief.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Manage sessions, assets, versions and provenance.

model_hub.title: Model Hub
model_hub.subtitle: Install and manage the local models behind each workflow.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Control storage, compute, appearance and diagnostics.

runtime.cancel_production: Cancellation requested — finishing the current step safely...

runtime.production_subtitle: Describe the song, then review each production step.

runtime.production_brief_description: Describes the song for the producer.
runtime.production_lyrics_description: Shows the lyrics created during production.
runtime.production_demo_description: Allows a clearly labeled demo fallback when production cannot complete.
runtime.load_failed: That audio could not be loaded into the selected workspace.
runtime.reference_failed: Song Forge could not load that audio.
runtime.register_failed: Could not add this audio to the project: {error}
runtime.no_audio_input: Audio loaded in Mixer because this view has no audio input.
runtime.busy_unload: A background task is still running; the active model was kept loaded.
runtime.task_description: Runs this task in the background and keeps progress recoverable.
runtime.send_to_mixer_unavailable: This sound cannot be sent to Mixer.
runtime.vocal_demo_conversion: The current voice conversion engine provides a clearly labeled demo conversion.

runtime.rerender_project_failed: The re-rendered file could not be added to the project.

lyrics.temperature_help: Higher = more creative, lower = more predictable

song_forge.timestep_shift_help: ACE-Step XL Turbo schedule shift (1, 2, or 3)

recovery.intro: Tasks, logs, crash reports, settings backups, and project versions are bounded by age, count, and size. Preview always runs first; active, recoverable, and pre-restore records are never removed.
recovery.preview_summary: Preview only — nothing removed. {count} item(s) would be removed, freeing {size} MB.

messages.locale_changed: Interface language saved. Restart Slunder Studio to rebuild all translated views.

credentials.available: Secrets are stored in {backend}. They are never written to config JSON, backups, or diagnostics.
credentials.unavailable: No OS credential service is available, so secrets cannot be stored.
